question: From which knot do the three proceed in this teaching?
premises: The brahma knot is situated as a starting point
The teaching is addressed to the beautiful-faced one
inference: The three proceed from the brahma knot.
uncertainties: The referent of etāṃ and trīṇi is not explicit in this verse
plain_english: Situated at the brahma knot, from here indeed are the three, O beautiful-faced one.
